versions.title: Track System Updates and Versions
newFeatures: Added a version monitoring system so users can see the latest updates for each system
Users can now view update history including old versions
Centralized the version monitoring data using GitHub so all LGU systems use one shared JSON file instead of separate copies
improvements: Made it easier for users to see what changes were made in each update
Improved tracking of system updates so users can understand changes over time
Improved maintainability by using a single centralized JSON source, so updates automatically reflect across all LGU systems

versions.title: Cedula System Timestamp Tracking and DOC_TRACK Audit Trail Enhancement
newFeatures: Added timestamp tracking feature in the Cedula System for monitoring transaction processing flow
Created dynamic yearly DOC_TRACK tables in the Timestamp Database for organized transaction logging and historical record management

Added transaction audit fields including Counter, ForYear, Acctno, Name, Address, ProcessTime, xTransaction, NextStep, Remarks, Remarks1, LoginName, FullName, ProcessTime_Begin, isWEB, Application_No, and xGroup
improvements: Enhanced transaction monitoring by storing detailed processing information including account details, processing time, transaction type, workflow steps, remarks, application number, and personnel information
Improved audit trail and process transparency for both web and office-based Cedula transactions
fixes: Fixed query to handle multiple account codes instead of only one

versions.title: Comprehensive Update: Government-Inspired UI Revamp, Digital Cedula Release, Email Notifications, and Automated LGU Employee Processing
newFeatures: Added email notification system for successful payments with instructions for taxpayers to visit LGU for physical Cedula claiming
Added Digital Cedula issuance that automatically generates and releases a digital copy after successful payment
Added LGU employee toggle feature with employee number verification modal, enabling automatic retrieval of employee information and auto-filling of Cedula form including automatic tax computation
improvements: Redesigned all Cedula pages with a more formal, government-inspired, clean and elegant layout for improved usability for both taxpayers and treasury users
Added skeleton loader when loading transaction counts per process to improve user experience and provide clear loading feedback during data fetching

versions.title: Initial Release of Revised Cedula System
newFeatures: Added Individual and Corporation Cedula form UI redesigned to mimic the physical cedula form for better familiarity and easier user understanding
Added validation in Individual Cedula form input including birthdate restriction (minimum age 15 years old)
improvements: Added additional input fields (`IncomeFromRealPropertyComputed`, `SalariesOrGrossComputed`, and `GrossReceiptsComputed`) and their corresponding database fields in the `CTC_Online_Application` table within the `SOS_TIMS` database for the existing Cedula form, based on the official physical Cedula format
Added validation trapping for Cedula form fields, including red danger indicators for empty or invalid inputs to emphasize required corrections
Improved Cedula issuance form layout for better usability and clarity
Improved tax computation and payment calculation process for accuracy
Improved treasury transaction management layout to match the taxpayer-side form design for consistency
Improved transaction filtering and search functionality for better record handling and navigation
fixes: Fixed tax computation and payment calculation issues
Fixed payment redirection issue to Universal Checkout
Fixed transaction count glitch that changes over time
Fixed rendering issue where pending and successful transactions were not properly separated
Fixed edit, approve, and reject functionality in treasury module
Fixed remarks handling so it only appears under approved or rejected transactions
Fixed filtering and search inconsistencies in treasury transactions
